jobs.title: Construction Programme Director
jobs.full_description:
Horizon Development is recruiting a Construction Programme Director to lead delivery across a portfolio of major destinations in the GCC.

  • Own programme-level delivery strategy and governance.
  • Coordinate consultants, contractors and authorities.
  • Report programme performance to the executive committee.

Requirements:

  • 15+ years of major project delivery experience.
  • Deep GCC programme experience.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management.

jobs.title: Design Review Manager
jobs.full_description: Coordinate design reviews and consultant deliverables for destination projects.
